A tracheostomy was placed on day 13. He remained in the ICU through day 45.

public_health_question.v: What lessons for vaccination vigilance and communication does a tetanus case in an unvaccinated Mexican-born worker in Oregon offer?

ev.q: This preventable tetanus case highlights the importance of equitable communication practices in health care settings, vigilance for serious but rare vaccine-preventable diseases
